mapper.insert: INSERT INTO gn_file (original_name, stored_name, url, size_bytes, content_type, uploader_kind, uploader_id) VALUES (#{originalName}, #{storedName}, #{url}, #{sizeBytes}, #{contentType}, #{uploaderKind}, #{uploaderId})
mapper.select: SELECT id, original_name AS name, url, size_bytes AS size, content_type AS contentType FROM gn_file ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT #{limit}
